verdict.rationale: Salv is an AML screening platform, so PEP identification is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence only documents sanctions-list screening (fuzzy name matching, re-screening, AI match explanations) and shared fraud pools. Nothing in the pack mentions politically exposed persons, related-associate data, or source context for PEP profiles, and sanctions screening is an adjacent capability rather than PEP screening.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can identify politically exposed persons and related associates with supporting source context
